creatorStats.activeHoursTip: Timezone: Beijing (UTC+8). Each number is activity reports in that hour: entering a game counts as 1, and playtime is also reported about every 25 seconds (each report counts as 1). Higher means busier hours, not unique players. Refresh the stats page to see the latest data.

operator.pageDesc: Site-wide public work stats, promotions and recruitment

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Activity, registration and points consumption trends for public works
reports.dauTip: DAU (Daily Active Users): distinct users who logged in at least once on a given day. This report buckets logins by Asia/Shanghai calendar days.
reports.averageDauTip: Arithmetic mean of daily DAU across the selected range. DAU counts distinct users who logged in at least once per day.
reports.peakDauTip: Highest single-day DAU in the selected range. DAU counts distinct users who logged in at least once per day.
reports.newUserRetentionHint: Shows {{daysLabel}} retention for users who registered on each date, including numerator and denominator
reports.activeUserRetentionHint: Shows {{daysLabel}} retention for users active on each date, including numerator and denominator
reports.rechargeTrendHint: Recharge amount, paid orders and paying users over time
reports.rechargeSummaryHint: Use the trend chart for timing and the two breakdowns below for structure by plan and order type

recruitment.totalInvitesTip: Invite codes successfully used during the selected period. Counted after a new user registers and binds via the code. Not the same as promotion submissions.
recruitment.submissionsTip: All promotion submission records, including pending, approved, and rejected. This is not the same as valid invites.
recruitment.activeEntryUsersTip: Distinct users who entered a game at least once during the period (game_entry event). Reflects actual play activity.
